tailoring.headline: Team Lead SAP CX & Lead-to-Cash | Senior SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Developer | Java & Integration Expert
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years delivering SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) solutions for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Expert in Java, Spring, REST/OCC APIs and end-to-end PIM-ERP-MDM integrations that support Lead-to-Cash processes. Proven in designing data pipelines, API migrations and production support while bridging business and IT through techno-functional analysis, stakeholder management and agile delivery.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Team Lead SAP CX & Lead-to-Cash
cover_en.hook: I am excited about Arvato Systems’ reputation for driving digital transformation in the SAP CX landscape. With over five years of hands-on experience building SAP Commerce Cloud solutions for Rockwell Automation and Shell, I have deep expertise in the Lead-to-Cash value chain. My background combines technical delivery with techno-functional consulting, exactly the blend you seek for this role.

bullets.label: Integration Expertise
bullets.text: Designed and optimized PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines and resolved ERP/MDM integration bottlenecks, ensuring seamless Lead-to-Cash flows.

bullets.label: Leadership & Mentoring
bullets.text: Provided technical guidance, performed code reviews and mentored junior developers, fostering high-performing agile teams.

bullets.label: API Development
bullets.text: Built and exposed OCC REST web services and headless APIs that powered storefronts and third-party integrations.

bullets.label: Process & Business Analysis
bullets.text: Collaborated with international business stakeholders to translate requirements into functional specifications and user stories.

cover_en.logistics: Karlsruhe, valid German work permit, serving notice until 15 December 2026, available from 16 December 2026, happy to discuss further

cover_de.subject: Bewerbung als Team Lead SAP CX & Lead-to-Cash
cover_de.hook: Arvato Systems steht für innovative SAP-CX-Lösungen, die Unternehmen im Lead-to-Cash-Prozess voranbringen. Mit über fünf Jahren Erfahrung in SAP Commerce Cloud-Projekten bei Rockwell Automation und Shell bringe ich fundiertes Know-how in den Bereichen Integration, API-Entwicklung und Business-Analyse mit. Meine techno-funktionale Expertise passt ideal zu den Anforderungen dieser Position.

bullets.label: Integration Expertise
bullets.text: Entwarf und optimierte PIM-zu-Hybris-Datenpipelines und löste ERP/MDM-Integrationsengpässe, um reibungslose Lead-to-Cash-Prozesse sicherzustellen.

bullets.label: Führung & Mentoring
bullets.text: Leitete technische Guidance, führte Code-Reviews durch und betreute Junior-Entwickler, wodurch agile Teams effizienter wurden.

bullets.label: API-Entwicklung
bullets.text: Erstellte und veröffentlichte OCC-REST-Web-Services sowie Headless-APIs für Storefront- und Drittanbieter-Integrationen.

bullets.label: Prozess- & Business-Analyse
bullets.text: Arbeitete eng mit internationalen Fachbereichen zusammen, um Anforderungen in funktionale Spezifikationen und User-Stories zu überführen.

cover_de.logistics: Karlsruhe, gültige Arbeitserlaubnis, letzter Arbeitstag 15.12.2026, Verfügbarkeit ab 16.12.2026, freue mich auf ein Gespräch

tailoring.why_company: Arvato Systems is a market leader in end-to-end digital commerce, combining deep SAP CX expertise with a strong focus on innovation and customer success. I am drawn to your commitment to agile, AI-supported delivery and the opportunity to shape large-scale Lead-to-Cash transformations for top-tier clients, where my SAP Commerce Cloud background can add immediate value.
tailoring.motivation_short: I want to help Arvato Systems accelerate SAP CX projects by applying my proven SAP Commerce Cloud, integration and techno-functional expertise to deliver high-impact Lead-to-Cash solutions.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I’m Kranti Chavan, a senior SAP Commerce Cloud developer with 5+ years of Lead-to-Cash integration experience. I’m eager to discuss how I can contribute to Arvato Systems’ SAP CX initiatives. Let’s connect!
tailoring.offer: In the first months I will modernize your SAP Commerce Cloud environment, streamline PIM-ERP-MDM integrations and deliver robust OCC APIs that accelerate Lead-to-Cash cycles. My hands-on experience with CI/CD, Docker/Kubernetes and AI-assisted development will also boost delivery speed and quality.
tailoring.email_subject: Application – Team Lead SAP CX & Lead-to-Cash
tailoring.email_body: Sehr geehrte Damen und Herren, ich bin Kranti Chavan, Senior SAP Commerce Cloud Developer aus Karlsruhe mit über fünf Jahren Erfahrung bei Rockwell Automation und Shell. Ihre Vorreiterrolle im SAP-CX-Umfeld begeistert mich, und ich kann sofort mit meiner Expertise in Integration, API-Entwicklung und Lead-to-Cash-Prozessen Mehrwert schaffen. Gerne bespreche ich, wie ich Ihre Projekte unterstützen kann. Mein Lebenslauf und Anschreiben liegen bei.
